Container.Name: ddns-ipv64-update
Container.Overview: #### DDNS Updater in Docker for Free DynDNS IPv64.net (https://ipv64.net/) - ONLY FOR IPV4 -

Config.Name: CRON_TIME
Config.Description: Time interval for current IP check

Config.Name: CRON_TIME_DIG
Config.Description: Time interval for domain check (dig DOMAIN_IPV64 A)

Config.Name: DOMAIN_KEY
Config.Description: DOMAIN KEY: Your domain key or DynDNS update hash found at https://ipv64.net/dyndns

Config.Name: DOMAIN_IPV64
Config.Description: YOUR DOMAIN: e.g., your-domain.ipv64.net found at https://ipv64.net/dyndns

Config.Name: DOMAIN_PRAEFIX
Config.Description: YOUR DOMAIN PREFIX (subdomain): ⚠️ Use only one prefix ⚠️ e.g., ddns

Config.Name: DOMAIN_PRAEFIX_YES
Config.Description: Default: no; DOMAIN PREFIX YES: This activates the domain prefix usage. Default: no

Config.Name: IP_CHECK
Config.Description: The IP address of the domain will be checked

Config.Name: SHOUTRRR_URL
Config.Description: SHOUTRRR URL: Your Shoutrrr URL as a notification service e.g. (gotify, discord, telegram, email) https://containrrr.dev/shoutrrr/latest/services/overview/

Config.Name: NAME_SERVER
Config.Description: The nameserver to check the IP address of your domain

Config.Name: NETWORK_CHECK
Config.Description: Connection to ipv64.net will be tested

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Permissions for user ID of the folder /data in the container

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: PGID: Permissions for group ID of the folder /data in the container
